result.justification: The paper presents a clear and specific objective, and the methodology is detailed and comprehensive, allowing for understanding and reproducibility of the study.

objective_evidence.quote: This study aims to investigate the genetic features of the hemagglutinin (HA) genes of influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria viruses circulating in Japan during the 2023–2024 season.

method_evidence.quote: Total viral RNA was extracted from 140 µL of clinical specimen using the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit (QIAGEN, Hilden, Germany), and reverse transcribed into complementary DNA (cDNA).
